item.title: Beshear vetoes House Bill 1, citing concerns over diverting public school funding
item.description: FRANKFORT, Ky., (KBSI) — Andy Beshear has vetoed House Bill 1 from the 2026 regular session of the Kentucky General Assembly, citing concerns about diverting public education funding to private schools. In a veto message issued from the Office of the Governor of Kentucky, Beshear said he rejected the bill under authority granted by Section 88 of the Kentucky Constitution....
